targets.name: SBOM visibility
targets.guidance: Inspect dependency manifests, lockfiles and SBOM generation/configuration. Component completeness, maintenance status and current advisories require inventory and external lifecycle evidence.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Third-party ingestion
targets.guidance: Inspect dependency pinning, integrity/provenance checks and package sources. Supplier trust and ingestion policy require external evidence.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Hard-coded passwords
targets.guidance: Trace password/credential literals into authentication or connection APIs. Exclude placeholders, test fixtures and non-secret identifiers; never reproduce secret values.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Cryptographic protection and access control
targets.guidance: Trace sensitive data through transport/storage and authorization decisions. Check encryption and principal/resource access checks; absence in one segment is not proof of missing controls.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Connection string injection
targets.guidance: Trace user-controlled values into connection-string construction; inspect builders, escaping, allowed keys and downstream credentials.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: LDAP injection
targets.guidance: Trace external input into LDAP filters and distinguished names. Check context-appropriate LDAP escaping; concatenation alone does not prove taint.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: SSI injection
targets.guidance: Check untrusted input entering server-side include directives and generated HTML consumed by an SSI-enabled server; identify configuration and input control.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: JWT use
targets.guidance: Inspect JWT signature, algorithm, issuer, audience and expiry validation. Distinguish decoding from security validation; inspect middleware/callers. Use CWE-347 for supported signature verification failures; use current session-specific mappings where appropriate.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: REST authorization
targets.guidance: Inspect server-side route authorization, policy registration, middleware ordering and anonymous exceptions across entry points and graph connections.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: User-controlled object keys
targets.guidance: Trace caller-controlled object identifiers to data access. Check owner/tenant/resource authorization rather than authentication alone.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Client-side authorization
targets.guidance: Compare browser permission checks to server enforcement at the corresponding route. UI gating alone is insufficient evidence of a vulnerability.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Unsafe unmanaged code
targets.guidance: Inspect unmanaged/native boundaries and pointer/buffer operations. Cite actual bounds or lifetime mistakes, not merely unsafe blocks or interop declarations.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Automatic security updates
targets.guidance: Inspect update signature/version checks and update configuration. Release notifications, operational patching and support policy require external evidence.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Insufficient logging
targets.guidance: Inspect security-sensitive operations and associated audit paths. Identify the required event and logging call chain; absence in a snippet is not sufficient.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: SSRF
targets.guidance: Trace attacker-controlled destinations, redirect handling and DNS/IP validation into outbound requests. Check allowlists and network assumptions.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Dynamic code/class loading
targets.guidance: Trace untrusted class/module names or paths into dynamic loading/reflection. Loading fixed trusted types is not a weakness. Map specific unsafe reflection to CWE-470, not deprecated CWE-545.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Clickjacking
targets.guidance: Inspect frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options policies and sensitive UI operations. Effective browser/server configuration remains unverified statically; prefer CWE-1021 for framing failures.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: CSRF
targets.guidance: Inspect state-changing routes, cookie authentication, anti-forgery validation, SameSite and origin controls. Bearer-only non-cookie APIs are counterevidence.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: SQL injection
targets.guidance: Trace untrusted values into SQL command structure. Check parameter binding, identifier allowlists and ORM query generation.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: IPC handling
targets.guidance: Inspect IPC endpoints, peer authentication, message authorization, permissions and payload validation. Android-specific CWE IDs require Android component evidence; do not force them onto Windows IPC.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Patching and insecure libraries
targets.guidance: Inspect package version/lock information and update configuration. Current vulnerability advisories and deployed versions are required to establish vulnerable dependencies.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Integer wraparound
targets.guidance: Trace integer arithmetic, casts, allocation sizes and bounds; check overflow/underflow guards and signedness. Arithmetic alone is not a finding.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Unnecessary privileges
targets.guidance: Inspect service identities, installer permissions, impersonation and privilege dropping. Required capabilities and effective deployment permissions need contextual evidence.
targets.mappingNote: Grouping/deprecated references are retained for traceability, not emitted as vulnerability mappings.

targets.name: Client-side local storage
targets.guidance: Trace sensitive data into browser localStorage/sessionStorage and other stores without access control. Establish data sensitivity and exposed principal context.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Dangerous functions
targets.guidance: Inspect inherently dangerous APIs and safer alternatives. Identify the operation and applicable exact CWE; presence alone may need call-path review.
targets.mappingNote: Use the most precise supported weakness; related checks do not prove full category coverage.

targets.name: Unchecked buffer copies
targets.guidance: Trace source size and destination capacity through native copy/allocation calls, check guards, termination and signed conversions. Resolve bounds before asserting overflow.

targets.name: XSS
targets.guidance: Trace untrusted values into HTML/DOM/template sinks. Check output-context encoding, sanitizers and framework default escaping.

targets.name: Information exposure
targets.guidance: Inspect responses, logs, errors, debug flags and environment exposure for sensitive data. Establish sensitivity and unauthorized audience.

targets.name: XML validation
targets.guidance: Inspect XML schema validation and parser settings at untrusted boundaries. Missing schema validation (112) and external entity expansion (611) are separate checks.
